title: LSDOU application order and same-container link order with observable winners

provenance.note: Windows precedence behavior (site, domain, OU; later application wins conflicts; lower link order applies last and wins) is long-established documented behavior, but this lab has no captured gpresult evidence yet; first execution must confirm or correct every expected winner.

operator_meaning: Five GPOs all write the same value so the winning GPO is observable from the endpoint, not merely the applied set
ChildB also writes a non-conflicting value so its participation is observable even though it loses the conflict

winners.reason: LSDOU: child OU applies last; within the child, link order 1 applies after order 2 and wins
non-conflicting values from losing GPOs still apply
the conflict loser still contributes its unique values

derivations: Application order is site, domain, parent OU, child OU; within one container, higher link order applies first, so order 1 is the final writer and wins conflicts.
Studio's compute_rsop must agree with gpresult on both the applied set and every winning value; an applied-set match with a wrong winner is a fail, per WP-6.
